# Verified dependency pins for the quadsim platform (Isaac Sim 5.1.0 + Isaac Lab v2.3.2).
# Use with: pip install -c env/constraints.txt ...
# packaging is not pinned here: Isaac Sim 5.1 requires packaging==23.0 while tensordict's pyvers requires >=25,
